en.html:
Me, Konatsu, Tadayasu, and Ritsu Kazama. Four people, one team. Competing in nothing, but a team all the same.

Ritsu was our age. Of the four, her life had the least supervision and she supplied the most. Everybody's didi, self-appointed. Maybe to support this authority, she always reached school early and scolded whichever of us arrived after her.

Khud early aao, get lonely waiting, get angry about the loneliness, then charge us for the whole operation.

Talk to the other early arrivals? Arre, those were model students. Ritsu was also a model, but of what not to do. No common subject could survive between them.

So we received the accumulated grievance. Mostly me. Kyun me? Genuinely, where had I signed?

Unlike Konatsu, she used no violence. A civilized woman. She used words. I could already hear them.

Same fluttering voice. Which meant he was serious.

Haan, this part was real. That was the thing about Tadayasu. Becoming a professional racer meant getting past one gate after another, and he was actually working toward them.

Always studying, gathering information. Running every morning for stamina. Swimming too, without skipping; they said you couldn't handle a crucible properly without it.

For the real technique, he would need a machine. He meant to earn that money by working in his father's business for a few years after graduation. So he studied for that as well. The dream had homework attached, and he was doing the homework.

Crucibles cost money. A racing model was nothing beside a combat tsurugi—you couldn't even buy those on the open market—but rare enough. An outdated secondhand one, still at least a million. Forget the family car. Even his dream's price had a different upbringing.

His father worked in a trading company. In this world, that counted as elite. Tadayasu could reasonably hope to earn the money in a few years. Lucky, certainly. But most people would still have said chhodo yaar and found a cheaper wish.

This fellow had no apparent weight anywhere. Where had he kept such a spine?

"Enough land to maintain the house, bas. Divide the rest into domains and let those fellows run them. But don't let them become too rich, na. Castle repairs, flood-control works—keep handing them expensive jobs. Their wealth must not start getting ideas.

"And somehow this made a practical government. Local people managed local things. The center, knowing nothing about them, had the excellent qualification of keeping quiet.

"If Ieyasu had got greedy and tried to govern every corner personally, I think history would have come out very differently."Suzukawa"Good. Sit."

en.text:
Konatsu and I were standard-issue aam aadmi. Tadayasu's family was comfortably above middle class.◆ Why he came to this ordinary school, honestly, no idea.◆ But information reached him that never reached us.

Maybe something had connected. Some piece we didn't have.

Nobody told us to be quiet. We shut up anyway and waited.

Tadayasu spoke with terrible weight.

Tadayasu"Telephone and ask?"
Suzukawa"There's no telephone at Kazama's."
Yuhi"Bhai, yours is the only house with one."
Tadayasu"Achchha! That explains why ours is useless."
Konatsu"Bas, enough of the intelligent conversation. Sir, I don't like saying it loudly, but staying out all night isn't so unusual for her."
Suzukawa"I know. Her family isn't very worried yet. I don't mean to raise an alarm either."

en.html:
Suzukawa"Kazama should be fine. Underneath it all, a sensible girl. Nitta goes missing, now that would make me panic."
Yuhi"Sir, meri kya galti? Why have I become the comparison?"
Konatsu"Because you're too childish to know why."
Tadayasu"But a child who knows he is a child is no longer a child. Arre wah, Yuhi! Philosophy has come out of you by accident!"
Yuhi"Chup kar."
Suzukawa"A joke. Sorry for disturbing lunch. Eat properly, get some exercise. Afternoon class mein no sleeping, haan?"
Konatsu"Yes, sir!"
Yuhi"Ji, ji."

雄飛「なんでそこで引き合いに出されるのがおれ なんだよう、先生……」
小夏「それがわからないくらい子供だからよ」
忠保「子供であることに気付けば子供ではないの だけど。あ、なんか哲学を発見したよ雄飛！」
雄飛「やかましい」
鈴川「冗談だ。 　食事中に邪魔をして悪かったな。ちゃんと 食って運動もしとけ。午後の授業寝るなよ？」
小夏「はーい！」
雄飛「うぃーっす」
